name: Shalmaneser
overview: The Scriptures reveal Shalmaneser as the king of Assyria who played a decisive role in the downfall of the northern kingdom of Israel. Under his reign, Israel's king Hoshea became a servant and paid tribute, but when Hoshea conspired with Egypt and ceased tribute, Shalmaneser besieged Samaria for three years. Ultimately, in the ninth year of Hoshea, Shalmaneser captured Samaria, deporting the Israelites to Assyria and surrounding regions, fulfilling God's judgment on Israel for their unfaithfulness.
